newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia wool indicator drops 14 cents to 704c/kg.
newsitem.headline: Australia wool indicator drops 14 cents to 704c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator dropped 14 cents to 704 cents a kg clean on Tuesday at sales in Sydney and Melbourne, Wool International said.
Merino fleece dropped, with 19/21/25 microns two percent down, 20m 1.5 percent down, 22m 3.5 percent down, 23m 2.5 percent down, 24m up to three percent down and 26m one percent cheaper.
Merino skirtings of 19m were slightly cheaper, with 20/21m one percent down and 22m up to two percent cheaper.
In crossbreds, 27m was 0.5 percent cheaper, 28m slightly cheaper, 29m slightly dearer and 30/31m up to one percent cheaper.
In cardings, both centres reported a generally unchanged market compared to last sales in each.
WI said Western Europe and Japanese interests were principal buyers with good support from most sectors of the trade.
Of the 29,551 bales offered, 12.2 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Wednesday in Sydney and Melbourne with about 31,000 bales to be offered.
